company.name: spiderSilk
company.shortDescription: spiderSilk is a cybersecurity company that develops software for external attack surface monitoring and threat detection.
company.description: spiderSilk is a cybersecurity firm, specializing in simulating the most advanced cyber offenses on your technology so you can build your best security defenses. Our proprietary machine-driven technology dramatically enhances the capabilities of our human ethical hackers, thereby leveraging both the power of machines with the creativity of humans. We focus on finding security exploits/vulnerabilities in applications residing on public and/or internal infrastructures. Our methodologies and “super-hackers” allow us to achieve simulations with the highest impact, and as a result we have uncovered threats that would have impacted over 120 million human beings in aggregate. Our enterprise security testing offerings are also backed by robust Advisory Services that are designed to provide visibility into areas of needed improvement within an organization, as well as to highlight areas where best security practices can be integrated.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that continuously scans the open internet to identify and attribute assets to organizations, providing visibility into attack surfaces and monitoring for threats without requiring any integration or deployment.

productsAndServices.description: Services designed to simulate cyber-attacks on web and mobile applications to identify vulnerabilities and assess security, combining machine simulations with human creativity to create advanced attack scenarios.
